output_list.criticism: This function is the constructor of the token. The initialSupply is hardcoded to 1000000000000000, which means that the initial token supply is 1000000000000000 INT. This is too much supply for a token, which can lead to: 1) Token holder may not be able to transfer all tokens out of contract. 2) Token holder may not be able to sell all tokens. 3) Token holder may not be able to buy all tokens.
